title: Multiple Purchase Chains with Negative Transfer Elimination for Multi-Behavior Recommendation

layout.note: A main row of three blue-outlined boxes (Initialization Module, Multiple Purchase Chain, Aggregate) joined by green block arrows; a top band with the interaction graphs and the negative-graph example; an enlarged BT Module below the middle box tied by a dashed cone; the Joint Learning Module below the right box.

lesson: Keep one colour per behaviour on every glyph that belongs to it (graph edges, embedding tiles, loss terms), so the reader can follow a behaviour through a dense multi-module figure, and enlarge the one new module with a dashed cone.
